title: When Answer Decodability Is Not a Decision: Separating Final-Answer and Imminent-Emission Signals in Chain-of-Thought
summary: Controlled probing found that, for the tested tasks/models, a strong readout of the eventual answer can instead track the candidate about to be emitted; the authors include counterexamples and explicit limits. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
